arguments.dimensional_entity_definition: Customer organization with Salesforce account details and SAP customer-master identity and address details.
arguments.dimensional_entity_grain: One row per customer organization identified by the shared SAP customer number; Gold retains Type 2 history.

sources.dimensional_entity_source_note: Map one Silver account row per shared CustomerNumber to its customer dimension record; retain the Silver values as descriptive attributes and track changes with Gold Type 2 history.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold surrogate key uniquely identifying a customer dimension version.
Shared SAP customer number identifying the business account across Salesforce and SAP; the natural key of the customer.

arguments.dimensional_entity_definition: Person associated with a customer or business account, with Salesforce contact details.
arguments.dimensional_entity_grain: One row per Salesforce contact identified by its Salesforce contact identifier; Gold retains Type 2 history.

sources.dimensional_entity_source_note: Map one Silver contact row by its Salesforce contact identifier to a contact dimension record; resolve the associated account to DimCustomer.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold surrogate key uniquely identifying a contact dimension version.
Salesforce identifier for the contact; the natural key of the contact.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the Salesforce contact identifier; use it to identify the contact.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold customer dimension key for the customer account associated with the contact.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Resolve the linked Silver Account row by its natural key CustomerNumber and use the corresponding DimCustomer key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Contact's given name.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the contact's given name.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Contact's family name.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the contact's family name.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Contact's email address.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the contact's email address.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Contact's phone number.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the contact's phone number.

arguments.dimensional_entity_definition: A customer's SAP sales-area assignment, including sales organization, distribution channel, division, and customer group.
arguments.dimensional_entity_grain: One row per customer and sales area, identified by customer number, sales organization code, distribution channel code, and division code; Gold retains Type 2 history.

sources.dimensional_entity_source_note: Map one Silver customer sales-area row for each composite customer and sales-area natural key; resolve the associated customer to DimCustomer.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold surrogate key uniquely identifying a customer sales-area dimension version.
SAP customer number in the sales-area natural key.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the customer number from the sales-area record; use as a component of its natural key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: SAP sales organization code in the sales-area natural key.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the sales organization code; use as a component of the sales-area natural key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: SAP distribution channel code in the sales-area natural key.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the distribution channel code; use as a component of the sales-area natural key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: SAP division code in the sales-area natural key.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the division code; use as a component of the sales-area natural key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold customer dimension key for the customer assigned to the sales area.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Resolve the linked Silver Account row by its natural key CustomerNumber and use the corresponding DimCustomer key.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Customer group assigned to the customer in this sales area.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Copy the customer group code for the sales-area assignment.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold customer dimension key for the customer account associated with the contact.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Resolve the linked Silver Account row by its natural key CustomerNumber, then use the DimCustomer version valid on this contact dimension row's ValidFrom date.

attributes.dimensional_attribute_definition: Gold customer dimension key for the customer assigned to the sales area.

sources.dimensional_attribute_source_note: Resolve the linked Silver Account row by its natural key CustomerNumber, then use the DimCustomer version valid on this sales-area dimension row's ValidFrom date.
